title.en: Housing and Development (Precincts for Lift Upgrading Works) Order 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Lift Upgrading Works) Order 2020 and comes into operation on 14 February 2020.

heading.en: Declaration of precinct for lift upgrading works

text.en: 2. The parts of the housing estate of the Board described in the Schedule are declared to be a precinct for the purpose of carrying out lift upgrading works.

THE SCHEDULE
All that part of the housing estate of the Board at Yishun Street 61 comprised in Lot number 02608X in Mukim 19 and on which Apartment Block 643 is erected, and which is more particularly delineated in the Plan.
THE PLAN
YISHUN STREET 61
